summary: --cpu engine installs resolve generic PyPI torch and pull the whole CUDA 13 stack (torch 2.13.0 bare, triton, 14 nvidia-* wheels). Root cause: --fast-deps routes through comfy-cli DependencyCompiler which ignores the vendor flag - the same fall-through already exempted for --m-series at engine.js:370-372. Measured from requirements.compiled on a GPU-less Linux box during MPI-391 section D. Wasteful, not broken. --amd suspect for the same reason.

Fix landed: --fast-deps is now used only for --nvidia (routes/engine.js), so --cpu and --amd take comfy-cli standard vendor-aware install. Stale comment rewritten to name all three vendors. Needs live confirmation of a +cpu torch resolve on the Linux box.

PARTIAL - stays in doing, do NOT close on the --fast-deps commit. Tested live on Linux: requirements.compiled is absent after a full install, which proves --fast-deps is genuinely off the --cpu branch, so this card diagnosis was correct for its stage. But the CUDA stack still installs - grep for "downloading (triton|nvidia)" returns 4 and the pip log shows torch, torchvision, triton and 14 nvidia-* wheels. Stage tags settle why: the original evidence was [comfy-install], the new lines are [system] [pip] = runPipCommand running ComfyUI-LTXVideo/requirements.txt with --upgrade. A --cpu engine has TWO paths to the CUDA stack; this card fixed one. Second path tracked as MPI-413. The 1.3.0 changelog entry claiming the processor-only build was REMOVED before publishing rather than shipped false.

This card half upgraded from indirect to POSITIVE proof during the MPI-411 run: [comfy-install] consulted https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu, resolved torch-2.13.0+cpu / torchvision-0.28.0+cpu / torchaudio-2.11.0+cpu, and installed no nvidia-*, triton or cuda-* package at that stage; venv confirmed torch 2.13.0+cpu straight after. Previously the only evidence was the ABSENCE of requirements.compiled. Sharpens MPI-413: the +cpu torch is the exact state the custom-node stage later overwrites with 2.13.0+cu130, so MPI-413 is a regression of a correct state rather than a failure to reach one. Card STAYS OPEN - still blocked on MPI-413.
Retitled to the scope it actually fixed (--fast-deps off the non-nvidia branch), which shipped and is positively proven on Linux. Residual symptom handed to MPI-413.
